[center](NOT AVAILABLE IN DEMO)
[title20]BINOCULARS
This is a handy pair of StarTech
Planetary Explorer binoculars, adjustable
for 10x through 30x magnification.
[title15]BURGER
This is a festering mass of congealed
fungus that you knew in former times as a
hamburger.
[title24]DEAD FISH
This is your basic, bloated, dead fish.
Although it is of an alien species, it is
just as disgusting as any dead fish you
have encountered on more familiar worlds.
[title26]STUFFED FISH
Apparently the dead fish wasn't disgusting
enough for you, so you have jammed that
festering burger down its throat, with
truly appalling results.
[title26]REBREATHER
This is an oxygen rebreather you picked up on
Cowplug VIII while you were stranded there
fixing your hyperdrive shunt.  Easily the
classiest way to see the Great Bovine Reefs
up close.
[title22]TIMER MODULE
This timer module was an integral part of your
ship until you crash landed here.  It still works,
but you probably shouldn't bet your life on it's
accuracy.
[title32]BIG LEAVES
The large green leaves barely fit in your
pockets.  They have strong veins and
look a bit like spinach leaves.
[title32]POISON DARTS
The tips of these blowgun darts have
been treated with chemical that when
introduced into the bloodstream causes
rapid cranial contractions.
[title32]PLANT STALK
This plant stalk has been lying on the ground
for a while.  The center has rotted out, leaving
a long round tube-like outer shell.
[title32]BLOWGUN
This handy little blowgun is the perfect
tool for propelling darts toward a target.
[title32]TWINKIFRUIT
This luscious little fruit looks almost too good
to be organic.  Something this tasty ought to
come in a cellophane wrapper.  It's a safe bet
that this is the tastiest, yummiest, most delicious
snack on the entire island.
[title32]BONE
It's not big enough to be a femur, nor is it
small enough to be a finger.  You're not exactly
sure what kind of bone this is.
[title32]CHICKEN
This juicy, golden-brown, roasted chicken makes
your mouth water.
[title32]SCALPEL
This surgical steel scalpel is quite sharp.  It also
appears to be very strong.  You should be careful
with this.
[title32]AUDIO TAPE
This standard ninety-minute audio tape is light
and compact.
[title32]CREDIT CHIP
This looks like an honest-to-goodness credit
chip!  If you started paying all your bills you
could probably qualify for one of these--in about 20 years.
[title32]SECURITY CARD
The woman on the card has a cold stare.  You take
comfort in the fact that she's monster food now.  The
security card has a small magnetic strip on it.
[title32]CHARGE CASES
These military compression cases are normally
used to contain explosive charges.  In their
current state of emptiness they are about as
dangerous as coffee cans.
[title32]<Deleted: Estrotoxin>
One day, this object will have a name.
[title32]BOMB
The detonator on this bomb looks sensitive.
You should be careful that you don't drop it.
[title32]TIME BOMB
By wiring your old timer module to the detonator
on this baby you have created a makeshift time bomb.
[title32]REPAIR LIST
Right now you SHOULD be reading it.
[title32]ALIEN LIQUOR
This looks like punchy stuff.  You never know what
to expect with booze from other planets.  From the
clarity of the liquor, you assume it to be about 195
proof.
[title32]TARGET MODULE
The quality of the target module impresses you.  With
this thing running a small ship's fire control computer,
you would be able to hit almost anything--hard and fast.
[title21]SHIELD MODULATOR
This type of shield modulator can increase the performance
of defensive screens by rapidly diverting power to the
point of impact.  Without one of these on the Pig,
you probably wouldn't be alive right now.
[title32]TAPE PLAYER
This state-of-the-art stereophonic tape player features
long-throw titanium-cone woofers, a 26-band tuner which
includes those hard to find bands such as gamma and graviton wave,
and a built-in atomic power plant that renders batteries
obsolete.
[title32]PHONE CELLS
These look like standard double-Q sized batteries,
[title32]PENLIGHT
This hand-held penlight would be convenient if
it weren't quite so large.  They must have big
pens on this planet.
[title32]"DURAFAIL" CELLS
This pair of double-Q batteries bear the
only name to trust your battery needs to.
Right.
[title32]FAKE ID CARD
The quality of this ID appalls you.  That
it may actually work around here strikes you
as nothing less than miraculous.
[title32]ID CARD
Now this is a decent ID.  It appears that
Buck had a decent security clearance too.
[title32]POLYCEMENT
This fast-drying all-purpose cement can be
used to repair broken plates, broken auto body panels,
broken teeth, and possibly broken marriages.
[title32]FISHING ROD
This quaint little fishing rod reminds you of
weekends spent fishing with your uncle.
Of course, all you ever caught was the flu.
[title32]FISHING LINE
This is the thin nylon line you removed
from the fishing rod.
[title32]PADLOCK KEY
Manufactured from something vaguely resembling
brass, this key has fared well over the years.
It is heavy for it's size.
[title32]DOOR KEY
This thin door key has the word "Schludge" engraved
on it.
[title32]REARVIEW MIRROR
You lifted this mirror from a
repair shop.  It is too small for a spaceship,
but it could be useful as a shaving mirror.
[title32]COMPACT
You never expected to find yourself carrying
one of these around.  The blush is a little dark
for you, but the mirror is in good shape.
[title32]<Deleted: Magnet>
One day, this object will have a name.
[title32]DETONATORS
These are military-grade detonators; they
are extremely sensitive.  An electrical charge
in the right place or a sudden jolt would set
these right off.  The four-prong design ensures proper
ignition of an explosive charge.
[title32]BOTTLE
This dirty old bottle had the audacity to be
floating around without a message in it.
[title32]CHICKEN BOMB
This incendiary fowl is sufficiently
dangerous to warrant great care.  You
may want to stop nibbling off of it now.
[title32]VASE
The beautiful lavender vase is worth
a lot of money to you.  After all you
went through to get hold of it you
wouldn't want to drop it.
[title32]REMOTE
This odd-looking remote control has only
one button on it.  It also has a small
inscription on the side: "Please return
to Goldenpipe Space Port".  Hmmm.

as you would expect something portable
to be.

sure what kind of bones these are.

wedding band.
